metadata.description: 69 skills, 20 agents, and 3 team workflows for software engineering: knowledge, tools, playbooks, frameworks, AI engineering, and agents, plus the loop-virtuoso Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: knowledge-virtuoso
plugins.description: 18 knowledge skills: design patterns, refactoring, SOLID, debugging, clean architecture, testing, API design, security, agent security, context engineering, docs lookup, scrum, performance, microservices, CI/CD, accessibility, database design, and motion design

plugins.name: tools-virtuoso
plugins.description: 15 tool skills: rules writer, ticket writer, agent creator, skill writer, plugin creator, research, brainstorming, ecosystem advisor, communication style, PR message writer, report writer, stakeholder update writer, UI review, web screenshot, and image annotate

plugins.name: playbooks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 11 playbook skills: ticket delivery, spec-driven development, TDD, branch finishing, PR feedback, handoff, worktree ops, hooks and guardrails, game feature loop, video production, and security research

plugins.name: frameworks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 12 framework skills: Symfony components, upgrade, Doctrine ORM and testing, Django components, LangChain components, PHP upgrade and quality, Composer dependencies, Godot and Godot upgrade, and Vercel AI SDK

plugins.name: ai-virtuoso
plugins.description: 4 AI engineering skills: agent design, LLM evals, LLM observability, and MCP server development

plugins.name: agents-virtuoso
plugins.description: 20 agents (specialists and roles), 3 team workflows, and the agent-orchestration and verification skills, plus headless wrapper skills for CI review, test gaps, migration planning, dependency audit, and refactor scans

plugins.name: loop-virtuoso
plugins.description: Claude Code only. A backlog-driven delivery loop that feeds the agent one small item at a time and accepts it only when verify commands pass and a write-boundary guard approves. Ships hooks, scripts, commands, and 2 skills
